$comment: 听力训练营 L18（P-L2）。脚本 100% 原创；阶段二 · Part 4 主旨三选一（5 段，每段含转折「本来想…但是…」，答案在 but 之后）+ Part 2 笔记填空（一段电话留言 5 空，五类混合：姓名拼读 S-A-S-H-A、日期（用 first/third 序数词）、地名拼读 G-R-E-E-N-W-A-Y、时间、电话号码）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 0.9x。
title: Birthday Plans
intro: 五段都在说生日，但每段都有一个「本来想…但是…」，答案在 but 后面。再听一条派对邀请留言，五个空五种类型：名字、日期、地点、时间、电话。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: I wanted to have my birthday party at home this year, with all my class. But Mum said thirty people is too many for our flat.
So we're having it at the swimming pool. They have a big room for the food, and we can swim for two hours.

questions.q: What is the girl saying about her party?
options: It will be at the swimming pool.
It will be at her home.
There won't be a party this year.
questions.explain: at home 是本来的想法，But Mum said… 之后改成 at the swimming pool。派对照开，只是换了地方。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: Mum, can I still have the new bike for my birthday?
I'm sorry, Tom. I was going to buy it, but the price has gone up, and it's too expensive now.
Oh. So what will I get?
The football game you wanted, and we'll save for the bike next year.

questions.q: What will Tom get for his birthday?
questions.explain: I was going to buy it, but… too expensive——自行车买不成了；So what will I get? → the football game。自行车留到明年。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: I was going to make Amy's birthday cake myself this year. I bought the eggs, the sugar, everything.
But this morning the oven stopped working. So I'll buy a cake from the shop on the way home, a chocolate one, her favourite.

questions.q: What does the man say about the birthday cake?
questions.explain: I was going to make… But the oven stopped working. So I'll buy a cake——转折之后是买。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: Ben, is your birthday picnic still on Saturday? The weather looks bad.
I know. We planned Saturday, but it's going to rain all day, so Mum moved it to Sunday.
Sunday is fine for me. Same place, the park by the river?
Yes, same place, twelve o'clock. Bring a ball!

questions.explain: We planned Saturday, but it's going to rain… moved it to Sunday。地点和时间没变，只改了日子。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，注意 but 后面说了什么。

script.text: Hi Lucy, it's Kate. My party card says three o'clock, and that's right for everyone else.
But could you come at two? I need help with the balloons and the table, and you're the best at that. Thanks!

questions.q: What does Kate want Lucy to do?
questions.explain: three o'clock 是给大家的时间，But could you come at two? 让 Lucy 早一个小时来帮忙。气球是要帮忙布置，不是带来。

sections.intro: 听一条派对邀请留言，把笔记补全。五个空五种类型：名字、日期、地名、时间、电话，名字和地名会拼出来。

script.text: Hello, this is a message for Amy from Sasha's mum. Sasha would like to invite you to her birthday party. That's Sasha, S-A-S-H-A.
Her birthday is on the first of May, but that's a Wednesday, so the party is on Saturday the third of May.
We're having it at Greenway Farm, that's G-R-E-E-N-W-A-Y, where you can feed the animals. Not Hill Farm, that's closed now.
The party starts at half past two and finishes at five. We'll have the birthday cake at four.
Please call me to say if you can come. My number is seven seven one, four oh eight two. That's seven seven one, four oh eight two.
Hope to see you there. Bye!

questions.explain: the party is on Saturday the third of May = 3 May。the first 是生日当天，但那天是周三，派对不在那天。
at Greenway Farm, that's G-R-E-E-N-W-A-Y。Hill Farm 已经关了。
the party starts at half past two = 2:30。five 是结束时间，four 是切蛋糕时间。
seven seven one, four oh eight two = 771 4082。号码会重复一遍。
